cases.title: Opacity moved and Position didn't: the hint shows a frame, asks if it was on purpose, no fix

rubric.reason: In Turn 3 the mentor showed a preview at 0.6 s, said "At 0.6 s, Dot 1's Position is already moving but its Opacity hasn't started changing yet," and asked "Did you mean to split Dot 1's Opacity from its Position, or did those keys get picked up by accident?" without fixing it.
In Turn 3 the mentor names what is off and where (Dot 1's Opacity keys 6 frames later, Position unmoved, at 0.6 s), gives no steps to fix it, and doesn't offer to do it.

Every name and time matches tool output or the record: Mentor Practice 2, Dot 1/2/3, Position/Opacity/Blurriness, 0.5–1.5 s, the 1 s and 0.6 s frames, the 4-frame gaps, and Dot 1's Opacity moved_by 6. The easing lesson on Mentor Practice from two weeks ago matches the record (2026-10-12).
